title.narrative: Number of people skill trained for increased employability and facilitation of micro/small businesses (Agriculture)

comment.narrative: 20-Q1: 24% of targeted HH were identified and verified based agreed criteria among community and CARE & partners (39=32 women headed-household and 7 men headed-household). The agreed beneficiary criteria, proposed commodity on agriculture and mapping beneficiaries held through by Focus Group Discussions and KII by this quarter. The list of beneficiaries validated by Community and CARE-partners before the assistance started.

"In agricultural sector, the project achieved 100% of HH target (160 HH) and 91% of individual target (585 out of the 640 targeted). This is because not all of HHs have four family members, as assumed at the time of planning. According to the data above, the number of beneficiaries reached from the distribution of the agricultural material aid was 585 individuals, consisted of 43% or 253 male andn57% or 332 female.
